drop.title: Drop your statement
drop.body: Drop your bank's PDF statement here. I read the amounts, the installments and the due date.

see.title: See what you will pay
see.body: On one screen you see how much you pay on each card this month and in which month your installments end.

ai.title: Connect an AI tool if you like
ai.body: If you connect the AI tool on your computer, it sorts your spending into categories and tells you where you can save.
ai.sent: The tool receives the date, description, amount, currency and type of each transaction in your statements, and your spending totals.
